title: Review: crypto2dev CryptoCb port for TLS integration
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — One genuine correctness bug (HMAC Final fallback after claimed Updates). The public API surface is small and well-documented for its major footguns (g_tls_safe_mode, single-threaded init). The ECDSA serialization and FIPS enforcement gap are operational risks that will generate bug reports from production deployments.
Confidence: 85% chance no missed P0 bugs. Uncertainty driven by: (1) real hardware behavior when CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT returns EOPNOTSUPP mid-use — only the sim was analyzed; (2) wolfSSL CryptoCb dispatch for HMAC was verified by reading hmac.c lines 923-930, 1051-1055 — the bug is confirmed. Would raise confidence if: integration test suite runs on real /dev/crypto2dev hardware; a test case is added that calls wc_HmacFinal on a device that rejects hmac(sha256) INIT and verifies the returned error code is not CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE.
